================================================================
INTERPRETATION AND VERDICT
================================================================

CLAIM UNDER TEST: our eight content character axes carry recoverable signal about the
AUTHOR disposition (grounding the person side of the coupling in labelled humans).

RESULT: WEAK BUT REAL AND DIRECTIONALLY INTERPRETABLE. All four MBTI dimensions are
predicted above chance by the eight axes taken together (OLS F tests all p < 1e-5;
multiple R between 0.16 and 0.21, so the axes jointly explain 2.6 to 4.4 per cent of the
variance in each dimension). This is a faint author signal, not a personality classifier.
The rubric recovers a trace of who wrote the text, well above chance and stable across
Pearson and Spearman, but small in absolute terms.

STRONGEST, MOST INTERPRETABLE MAPPINGS:
  affect      x Agreeableness (Feeling)     r = +0.158   Feeling types write with more
                                                          emotional, sensational affect.
  originality x Openness (iNtuition)        r = +0.142   iNtuitive authors read as more
                                                          original. Openness is the trait
                                                          tied to novelty and ideas, so
                                                          this is the cleanest hit.
  depth       x Extraversion                r = -0.131   Introverts write with more depth
                                                          (negative with Extraversion).
  depth       x Conscientious (Judging)     r = +0.121   Judging types read as deeper.
  rigour      x Conscientious (Judging)     r = +0.104   Judging types read as more rigorous.
  rigour      x Extraversion                r = -0.104   Introverts read as more rigorous.

  PC1 (matter versus manner): negative with Agreeableness (-0.106) and Extraversion
  (-0.098), positive with Conscientious/Judging (+0.084) and Openness (+0.078). The matter
  pole aligns with the disposition cluster you would expect to write substantively:
  Thinking, Introverted, Judging, iNtuitive. A coherent, single story across all four axes.

AGAINST THE PRE-STATED HYPOTHESES IN THE BRIEF:
  "does rigour/depth track Openness/Conscientiousness" — CONFIRMED. Both rigour and depth
  correlate positively with Conscientiousness (Judging) and with Openness (depth x Openness
  +0.099, depth x Conscientious +0.121, rigour x Conscientious +0.104). This is the cleanest
  confirmation of the stated prediction.
  "does affect track Extraversion/Neuroticism" — PARTIAL. affect tracks Extraversion
  positively but weakly (+0.077); its strongest partner is Agreeableness/Feeling (+0.158).
  Neuroticism could not be tested: MBTI has no Neuroticism axis, so that Big Five factor is
  simply absent from this dataset.

HONEST CONFOUNDS (why the ceiling is low, and why even this signal is soft):
  1. Labels are self reported MBTI self typing on a personality hobby forum, noisier than an
     administered Big Five instrument, and MBTI dichotomises continuous traits into binaries,
     which throws away information and caps any achievable correlation.
  2. The four label columns are deterministic dichotomisations of the sixteen MBTI types
     mapped to Big Five poles (E/I to Extraversion, N/S to Openness, F/T to Agreeableness,
     J/P to Conscientiousness). They are four binary MBTI axes, not continuous OCEAN, and
     there is no Neuroticism.
  3. Heavy self selection: PersonalityCafe skews wildly (iNtuitive base rate 0.87 against
     roughly a quarter to a third in the general population; Extraversion only 0.23). The
     sample is not representative, which compresses variance on some axes.
  4. Topic leakage: the forum is ABOUT personality and the posts openly discuss type. The
     scorer targets the voice, not type words, which limits but does not remove the leak.
  5. Off instrument use: the scorer was tuned on publication and domain character, then
     applied to individual forum authors, a distribution it was never fitted on.
  6. Small effect sizes. Read these as evidence of a faint but genuine person side signal,
     not as a working predictor of anyone's type.

BOTTOM LINE: the content character rubric does carry a recoverable, statistically robust,
directionally sensible trace of the author disposition, and the specific rigour/depth to
Openness/Conscientiousness mapping predicted in advance holds. The magnitude is small and
bounded by noisy binary self report labels and a heavily self selected sample, so the honest
statement is "recoverable signal, not recovery": enough to ground the person side of the
coupling in labelled humans, not enough to classify a person from their prose.
